request.style: English, male baritone solo, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, organ, solemn and reverent mood, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
From Babylon we came to the wall
Amariah and Malluch stand in the hall
Hattush is named in the ancient list
Restoring the temple, the faith is tested

[Chorus]
We seal the covenant with our hand
To follow the Lord with a steady command
Faithful to the law we have found
Bound to the Lord on holy ground

[Verse]
From the sons of Bani the names are read
Meshullam and Malluch, no longer dead
Adaiah and Jashub, Sheal and Ramoth
Sending away what is foreign and remote

[Chorus]
We seal the covenant with our hand
To follow the Lord with a steady command
Faithful to the law we have found
Bound to the Lord on holy ground

[Pre-Chorus]
On the left stood the kinsmen near
Ethan the son of Kishi, clear
Abdi the son of Malluch, true
Serving the Lord in the temple view

[Verse]
Of Malluch there was Jonathan
Of Shebaniah, Joseph is the man
Pashhur and Amariah, Malchijah too
Levites serving, the work to do

[Chorus]
We seal the covenant with our hand
To follow the Lord with a steady command
Faithful to the law we have found
Bound to the Lord on holy ground

[Outro]
Names are written in the book of days
Malluch stands in the holy ways
